highlights.title_en: Brain-Controlled Spinal Stimulation Walking Therapy After Incomplete Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
highlights.brief: 该临床试验评估脑控经皮脊髓刺激改善不完全性脊髓损伤患者行走，属非侵入式BCI临床进展。

items.title_zh: 脑控脊髓刺激行走疗法治疗不完全性脊髓损伤（BCI-TSCS）
items.title_en: Brain-Controlled Spinal Stimulation Walking Therapy After Incomplete Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT06406855测试脑控经皮脊髓刺激（TSCS）改善不完全性SCI后行走。
该方法属非侵入式，因为TSCS采用表面/经皮刺激而非植入电极。
发布于2026-10-02，其意义在于连接脑信号与运动功能恢复的转化型BCI康复试验。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT06406855 tests BCI-guided transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (TSCS) for walking after incomplete SCI.
The approach is non-invasive because TSCS uses surface/transcutaneous stimulation rather than implanted electrodes.
Published 2026-10-02, it matters as a translational BCI rehabilitation trial linking brain signals to locomotor recovery.
items.brief: 该临床试验评估脑控经皮脊髓刺激改善不完全性脊髓损伤患者行走，属非侵入式BCI临床进展。
items.brief_en: Clinical trial evaluating brain-controlled transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation to improve walking after incomplete SCI.
items.raw_excerpt: The purpose of this research is to test the effectiveness of a new therapy, called Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)-Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation (TSCS), for improving walking in people with an incomplete spinal cord injury (SCI).
